items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: They sent Louis Primer a card at Warren Easton High School. We come up together.

ctx.x: He's a good entertainer, man. Nice entertainer.

You see, at one time I come up right here. I'll tell you who come up. When Warline got a new Busha trumpet in, they sent me a card. They sent Sharky Banana a card. They sent Louis Primer a card at Warren Easton High School. We come up together. We'd go down there and get in a booth and get one of them sailmen to get on the piano. And we'd wake up with new trumpets. Now I'll come up with them fellas. Louis Primer went to Chicago. When I left, I went the wrong way to the wide open spaces of Texas. You understand? I…
